source.name: Kaggle — taruntiwarihp/phishing-site-urls
source.claimedRowCount: ~507,000 (per Kaggle page, not independently verified at write time)
source.claimedClassBalance: ~72% good / ~28% bad (per Kaggle page, not independently verified at write time)
source.provenance: Third-party curated dataset. Label semantics and label quality are inherited from the dataset. TRUSTVEX does NOT independently verify these labels.
source.license: See the Kaggle dataset page for the license declared by the uploader. If the license is unclear, treat the dataset as research-use only and do not redistribute.
source.usageDecision: Raw data is excluded from version control. Used locally for training the TRUSTVEX URL-Risk Model v1. The pipeline records the actual file hash and row counts at prepare time, so the manifest reflects reality rather than the source's advertised statistics.

positiveClass.semantic: labeled phishing (per source, not independently verified by TRUSTVEX)

negativeClass.semantic: labeled non-phishing (per source, not independently verified by TRUSTVEX)
negativeClass.terminologyWarning: Do NOT refer to these as 'verified benign' or 'confirmed safe' in any output, log, or report.

notUsed.reason: Indexes malware-distribution URLs, not phishing URLs. Used as a live reputation provider in the scanner, but 'no result' is never treated as a benign label.
Popularity ranking, not a ground-truth benign label set. Not used in v1 to avoid mixing methodologies and because the Kaggle dataset already provides both classes.
Registration for new accounts is currently disabled. Would have been the preferred phishing class source; kept in mind as a future external validation set.
